Rationale: Aligns with Kennedy’s stated preference for a “middle course” avoiding immediate
invasion[US_president]. Enables gradual escalation while demonstrating resolve. Supported by
State Department’s focus on maintaining international legitimacy[US-state_department].

preemptively[US_defense_department]. Supported by public hawkishness against Soviet
presence in hemisphere[US_public_opinion].

Rationale: Mirrors State Department’s “missile standstill” proposal[US_state_department],
leveraging OAS/UN channels for gradual pressure. Requires avoiding military provocation.
